name: client-python-durable-incremental-collection-3c8f
instr:
prometheus_client cannot resume incremental metric collection from portable cursors across restarts and multiprocess deployments. Add this while keeping full collection and Graphite delivery compatible when cursors are unused.

Export `ChangeKind`, `SourceCursor`, `CollectionCursor`, `MetricChange`, `DeltaCollection`, `CursorInvalidated`, `CursorFormatError`, `encode_cursor`, and `decode_cursor` from `prometheus_client`. `ChangeKind` is a Enum. Cursors compare deterministically only within their source and generation, keep registered collectors distinct, encode portably and deterministically, and reject malformed or unsupported encodings without partial results.

Incremental producers report updates and removals with stable metric identities and preserve atomic observations through restriction, copying, and reconstruction. Expired, foreign, unavailable, or discontinuous histories invalidate with current state and a resumable restart cursor. Registry and wrapper deltas include only changed labeled children, with revisions, while ordinary collection, ordering, equality, representation, and registration remain unchanged.

GC generations and procfs groups advance independently. Immutable platform observations appear once per compatible lineage. Unavailable runtime data or changed process and platform identities invalidate instead of fabricating observations.
